name: date-picker
title: Date Picker
description: A date field in the select's look that opens the calendar in a floating panel, with optional presets.
usage: Ask for a date or a range in a form or a toolbar (an API key's expiry, a usage report's window). Use DatePicker for one date and DateRangePicker for a range; presets add shortcuts (Last 7 days). Give it a name to submit ISO dates with the form.
avoid: Typing dates into a plain input without a calendar
Closing a range picker after the first day
